# Which pairing is worth making this season?

> Free ball python morph pairing planner. Enter your females and males with their morphs and hets and what each morph sells for; get the genetics odds for every pairing, expected hatchlings, clutch profit and the best pairing. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
